name: claudestacks
description: Execution engine: a TDD coder, a merged code+spec reviewer, and a read-only explorer, plus an orchestration driver, process guidelines, project-local memory, and /claudestacks:discuss — a communication protocol that keeps agent detail on disk behind numbered topics.

style_reinject.title: Re-send reply rules every prompt
style_reinject.description: Re-send the communication protocol's reply rules with every prompt. When off, they are still sent at every session start, /clear and compaction.

archive_keep.title: Discussions kept per project
archive_keep.description: How many /claudestacks:discuss discussions to keep per project besides the current one. Older ones are removed when a new one starts.
